Your first resume can be made free with these 5 tools.

Overleaf — https://www.overleaf.com/gallery/tagged/cv — LaTeX templates for résumés

FlowCV — https://flowcv.com/ — 100+ resume templates
Canva Resumes — https://www.canva.com/create/resumes/ — Hundreds of free templates
